summary: SEO Blog Platform feature end-to-end verified — backend + mobile web frontend at 390x844. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_blog_seo.py: 6/6 PASSED in ~43s (public /api/blog feed; category+q filters; auto-gen of canonical post on guide build; /api/blog/{slug} returns all enriched fields with no _id; /api/blog/{slug}/html returns SEO HTML with og:title + HowTo JSON-LD + share + ref=blog CTA; guide build still returns 200 — blog auto-gen properly try/except wrapped). Frontend: (1) /blog feed renders cards (testID blog-post-<slug>) with category, title, excerpt, product, views; category chips (blog-cat-All / blog-cat-Home-Repair / blog-cat-Kitchen) filter correctly (Kitchen chip → 1 post); search box (testID blog-search) filters on Enter ("drywall" → 1 post). (2) Tapping a card opens /blog/[slug] reader showing 'KITCHEN · Moen Adler 87233', H1 'How to Replace a kitchen faucet (Moen Adler 87233)', overview, 'What you'll need' (tools + materials), 9 numbered steps, 'Stay safe' block, 'Common mistakes to avoid', and orange CTA card. (3) Both share testIDs (blog-share in header, blog-share-btn primary) — on web with navigator.share absent, they fall back to navigator.clipboard.writeText + 'Link copied!' alert; URL copied is the SEO HTML /api/blog/<slug>/html; no crash, reader stays mounted. (4) Conversion CTA testID blog-start-project — when logged out, falls back to /onboarding (no crash); when logged in (TEST_blogui_<ts> with injected token), it POSTs /api/projects (200) and navigates to /project/<id>?new=1 with the workspace showing the inherited title 'Replace a kitchen faucet (Moen Adler 87233)' and the intake auto-starts ('Drafting plan… Getting a few details so your plan is exact…'). (5) Hamburger menu testID home-menu opens the menu modal; testID menu-blog 'DIY Guide Library' navigates to /blog and the feed mounts. (6) Regression: a second user's first guide build (Patch a small drywall hole) returns 200 — blog auto-gen does not break the guide endpoint. Deprecated styles detected: 'shadow*' deprecation + 'props.pointerEvents' (carryover, see iterations 7-8).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'; 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not introduced by this feature — seen since iteration 7. Reference: console output on every page load.

action_items: No blog-feature issues to fix. Optional carryover from iteration 8: cross-room memory bleed in relevant_memories() (server.py ~line 221) is still open and unrelated to blog.
Optional carryover from iteration 7/8: migrate deprecated 'shadow*' RN style props to 'boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents' to 'style.pointerEvents' to silence dev warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: maybe_create_blog_post() correctly de-dups by slug (canonical post per task+product) and is wrapped in try/except at server.py:776 — guide build is fully insulated.
public_blog/list_blog/get_blog/blog_html all exclude MongoDB _id via projection {'_id': 0}. Verified post detail JSON has no _id.
HTML route /api/blog/{slug}/html is a true HTMLResponse with og:title and HowTo JSON-LD — share targets are crawlable.
Blog endpoints are PUBLIC (no get_current_user dependency) — confirmed by passing requests with no Authorization header.

BlogPost.onShare correctly platform-branches: web tries navigator.share, falls back to navigator.clipboard with alert; native uses Share.share. No throw on missing navigator.share (try/catch around the entire branch).

BlogPost.startProject correctly redirects to /onboarding on auth failure (catch block). When auth ok, POST /projects returns {id} and router.push(/project/<id>?new=1) lands on the workspace which auto-runs intake.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (feed, filters, search, reader, share web fallback, CTA auth + unauth, menu-blog)

seed_data_creation: Registered TEST_blog_<ts>, TEST_blogui_<ts>, TEST_blogmenu_<ts> via /api/auth/register (all prefixed for cleanup). Two canonical blog posts already exist in DB and were exercised by the tests: 'replace-a-kitchen-faucet-moen-adler-87233' and 'patch-a-small-drywall-hole'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blog feature is fully working. /api/blog endpoints are PUBLIC. AsyncStorage on web is backed by localStorage with no prefix — to skip onboarding, register via /api/auth/register, take access_token, then `localStorage.setItem('diyhomie_token', JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(token)))` (storage wrapper double-JSON-stringifies because secureSet → setItem<string>). Note: secureSet passes value through JSON.stringify once, so the actual stored value is JSON.stringify(rawToken). To run only blog tests: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest /app/backend/tests/test_blog_seo.py -v -s. One guide build is ~30s; auth register uses access_token (NOT 'token') key.
rca_of_issue: No bugs detected in the blog feature.
